comment: The wall ring round an interior is wall, and the doorway in it is still a door. Until September 2026 every room built by mapkit.interior() had its wall top written in autotile shape 0, which is 0xe00 and blocks nothing, and the player could step off the floor on to the top of any wall and walk round the room on it (SITES.md step 18, NORTH.md 8.1f). build_game.shape_wall_tops gives the tops their edge shapes. This walks at every wall of two rooms - the Gilded Turnip, which is published and has been like this since the first commit, and the Bell, one of the last rooms built - and at both sides of each doorway, and then out through the door. Every push into a wall is made after a step along it, and asserts the facing as well as the position: the step proves the walk is live, and the facing proves the push was read, so a dropped key press cannot pass for a wall. The Turnip's washstand is walked to as well, because it stood on the east wall's top and had to move in when the wall stopped being walkable.
